Admission to the program is offered purely based on the NEET scores and through the Gujarat state counselling. Both private and government colleges recognized by the NCISM and NCH accept students under the State Quota and All India Quota.

Gujarat Ayush Counselling is supervised by the Admission Committee for Professional Undergraduate Medical Courses (ACPUGMEC) . For participating in the counselling, the eligible candidates need to register with the Gujarat Ayush Counselling official website at https://www.medadmgujarat.org/. Admission to the Ayush courses is only based on the NEET-UG scores of the current year.

While Ayurveda, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha & Homeopathy are the Ayush courses, Gujarat offers only BAMS and BHMS colleges. There are a total of 48 BHMS and 44 BAMS colleges in Gujarat as per the year 2025, according to ACPUGMEC.

The majority of the seats in the state are reserved for students with Gujarat domicile, with 85% of the seats allocated under the State Quota. Students from other states can apply to the Self-Financed BAMS and BHMS colleges under the All India Quota (AIQ), which reserves 15% of seats. The AIQ seats for counselling are under the Ayush Admissions Central Counseling Committee (AACCC) .

content.text: Entrance Examination

items: NEET-UG qualification is mandatory for admission to Ayush courses. Candidates must obtain a minimum mark of the 50th percentile in the NEET examination.
In case of reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC), the minimum mark to obtain is the 40th percentile in the NEET examination.

content.text: Age Limit

items: The age of the candidates must not be less than 17 years on 31 December of the year of admission.

items: The candidates who studied 10+2 in Gujarat can only apply to the private and government colleges under the Government and Management Quota.
The students with 10+2 from other states apart from Gujarat can apply for self-financed colleges under the 15% of AIQ seats.

Choice filling round is initiated for each round of allotment.

Stray Vacancy Round is only for the vacant seats after all 3 rounds.
Seats are allotted considering NEET scores, merit rank, reservation criteria, and choices of colleges
The Allotment List is published on the official website of ACPUGMEC. Candidates can log in with their credentials to view the result.
After the list is published, candidates should obtain the Provisional Allotment Order.
The candidates should pay the prescribed tuition fees to the allotted college by cash/DD.
Candidates must report to the allotted college with all the necessary original documents, including the Provisional Allotment Order, and get them verified.

cells: NEET qualified Candidates should register with the official website of AACCC, www.aaccc.gov.in . Provide necessary personal information and submit the application form by making payment of the prescribed fee.Upload relevant original documents and certificates.

Allotment is made to various institutions on the basis of NEET scores, merit rank, reservation, and choices of colleges.Allotment is processed in 4 rounds: Round 1/ Round 2/ Mop-up Round/ Stray Vacancy Round.The eligibility and participation rules for each round are different.

A final list of allotment is published on the official website of AACCC. Candidates can log in with their credentials to view the result.Candidates must download the Provisional Allotment Order after the publication of result.

The candidates should join the allotted college and produce the original certificates to them for verification.Make the payment of tuition fees prescribed by the allotted college to confirm admission.

Gujarat Ayush Counselling Overview

Gujarat Ayush Counselling is supervised by the Admission Committee for Professional Undergraduate Medical Courses (ACPUGMEC) . For participating in the counselling, the eligible candidates need to register with the Gujarat Ayush Counselling official website at https://www.medadmgujarat.org/. Admission to the Ayush courses is only based on the NEET-UG scores of the current year.

While Ayurveda, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha & Homeopathy are the Ayush courses, Gujarat offers only BAMS and BHMS colleges. There are a total of 48 BHMS and 44 BAMS colleges in Gujarat as per the year 2025, according to ACPUGMEC.

The majority of the seats in the state are reserved for students with Gujarat domicile, with 85% of the seats allocated under the State Quota. Students from other states can apply to the Self-Financed BAMS and BHMS colleges under the All India Quota (AIQ), which reserves 15% of seats. The AIQ seats for counselling are under the Ayush Admissions Central Counseling Committee (AACCC) .

Gujarat Ayush Counselling 2025- Key Highlights

Gujarat Ayush Counselling Eligibility Criteria

Below are the eligibility criteria for admission to Ayush courses. The candidates must strictly follow the requirements to participate in the Gujarat Ayush Counselling 2025.

Academic Qualification

The candidates should have passed in 10+2 and obtained a minimum aggregate of 50%, together in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology subjects, in the case of the general category, and 40% marks in the case of the reserved category (SC/ST/OBC).

Entrance Examination

NEET-UG qualification is mandatory for admission to Ayush courses. Candidates must obtain a minimum mark of the 50th percentile in the NEET examination.

In case of reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC), the minimum mark to obtain is the 40th percentile in the NEET examination.

Age Limit

The age of the candidates must not be less than 17 years on 31 December of the year of admission.

Domicile Requirement

The candidates who studied 10+2 in Gujarat can only apply to the private and government colleges under the Government and Management Quota.

The students with 10+2 from other states apart from Gujarat can apply for self-financed colleges under the 15% of AIQ seats.
